description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

description.zh: 指定需要连通的Elasticsearch实例的信息。
description.en: The information about the Elasticsearch instance to which you want to validate connectivity.

descriptions.zh: > 开启Logstash的X-Pack监控需配置Elasticsearch实例。配置后，即可在对应Elasticsearch实例的Kibana中监控Logstash实例。
descriptions.en: > To enable X-Pack monitoring for Logstash, configure an Elasticsearch instance. After the configuration, you can monitor the Logstash instance in the Kibana console of the corresponding Elasticsearch instance.
